decisions.electrical_failure_risk: Unintended conductive bridge between traces risking dead short, overcurrent, and thermal runaway.
decisions.root_cause_hypothesis: Under-etching, exhausted etchant bath chemistry, or developer residue between adjacent traces.
decisions.recommended_corrective_action: Scrap or isolate bridged board; titrate copper etchant solution and verify conveyor dwell speed.

decisions.electrical_failure_risk: Complete circuit discontinuity causing open signal net or interrupted power delivery.
decisions.root_cause_hypothesis: Over-etching, photoresist flaking, or mechanical scratch on photomask film.
decisions.recommended_corrective_action: Scrap defective PCB immediately; inspect photoresist lamination rollers and etchant spray nozzle pressure.
